page: Amazon Web Services r6gd.12xlarge is a memory-optimized virtual machine utilizing the AWS Nitro System hypervisor. The instance is powered by custom AWS Graviton2 processors running on the 64-bit ARMv8 Neoverse-N1 architecture at a fixed clock speed of 2.5 GHz. It provisions 48 dedicated physical cores with a one-to-one thread mapping, completely eliminating core sharing and simultaneous multithreading overhead. System memory totals 384 GB, providing a standard memory-optimized 1:8 vCPU-to-RAM ratio of 8 GB per core. The instance includes 2850 GB of integrated local NVMe SSD storage, and baseline network throughput is rated at 20 Gbps without bundled GPUs.

Benchmark evaluations demonstrate distinct multi-core scaling characteristics alongside expected single-threaded limitations inherent to the Neoverse-N1 architecture. Multi-threaded stress-ng results place the instance in the top quartile of tested hardware, achieving 72,827.05 points, while multi-core Geekbench reaches 12,842.0. Memory subsystem testing reflects 163.72 GB/s read throughput and 78.22 GB/s write throughput on uncached 256 MB blocks. Conversely, single-thread performance metrics, including Geekbench single-core at 971.0 and gzip compression at 20.28 GB/s, register in lower benchmark tiers, confirming that aggregate throughput is achieved via parallel concurrency rather than peak per-core frequency.

From an architectural standpoint, the inclusion of 2850 GB NVMe SSD storage reduces the reliance on external block volumes for ephemeral data, delivering high local I/O performance at favorable hardware density. Workloads requiring specialized x86 vector extensions such as AVX-512 will experience limitations due to the ARM instruction set, and large language model inference shows diminished generation throughput. However, the substantial memory pool combined with robust multi-threaded compute and local NVMe storage makes this instance effective for Redis and Memcached deployments, relational databases, real-time analytics engines, and distributed data processing pipelines.
description: Amazon Web Services r6gd.12xlarge is a memory-optimized instance built on the AWS Nitro System, featuring 48 physical cores powered by the 2.5 GHz AWS Graviton2 ARMv8 Neoverse-N1 processor. Operating with dedicated single-threaded cores, it provides 384 GB of system memory, establishing an 8 GB per vCPU allocation. Hardware provisions include 2850 GB of bundled local NVMe SSD storage and a 20 Gbps baseline network interface. Benchmark results indicate strong multi-core processing in stress-ng evaluations alongside consistent throughput in multi-threaded decompression and static web serving, though single-core Geekbench metrics show modest per-thread execution speeds. The combination of high memory capacity and direct-attached NVMe storage supports cost-efficient resource consolidation without requiring separate network storage volumes for high-throughput I/O. Amazon Web Services r6gd.12xlarge is suited for in-memory caches, Redis deployments, relational databases requiring fast scratch storage, and memory-intensive data processing pipelines.
